messages.content: Hey, weekly check-in from Northline Care. Do you have a blood pressure reading for me today?
Yep. 136 over 82. Took it about an hour ago.
Got it, I've logged 136/82 for today. Anything going on with your medications this week — missed doses, running low, any side effects?
Nope, nothing like that. Same as usual.
Good to hear. I'll have your next check-in scheduled for the same time next week. Take care.

theme: routine weekly check-in, reading logged, nothing else
